tasks.label: Regenerate flutter_rust_bridge Code
tasks.command: rm -rf lib/src/rust/*(N) && rm -f rust/src/frb_generated.rs && flutter_rust_bridge_codegen generate

tasks.label: Run Rust Tests
tasks.command: for toml in $(find . -name Cargo.toml -not -path '*/target/*' -not -path '*/.*'); do cargo test --manifest-path "$toml" || exit 1; done

tasks.label: Clean Flutter & Rust
args: if [ -f pubspec.yaml ]; then echo "Cleaning Flutter project in the root directory..."; flutter clean; fi; shopt -s nullglob; for dir in */; do if [ -f "$dir"Cargo.toml ]; then echo "Cleaning Rust project: $dir"; (cd "$dir" && cargo clean); fi; if [ -f "$dir"pubspec.yaml ]; then echo "Cleaning Flutter project: $dir"; (cd "$dir" && flutter clean); fi; done
